import hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path.cwd()
BASE = ROOT / 'docs/migration/lot4b-evidence'
PLAN = BASE / 'planning/regression-plan.json'
BINDING = BASE / 'planning/published-predecessor83.json'
OUT = BASE / 'recorded-regression-cases-final.json'
RECEIPT = BASE / 'planning/recorded-regression-cases-final-preparation.json'
assert not OUT.exists() and not RECEIPT.exists(), 'Outputs are exclusive'
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
records, git_blobs = {}, {}
object_format = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-object-format'], text=True).strip()
assert object_format in ('sha1', 'sha256')

def local(name):
    path = ROOT / name
    assert path.resolve() == path and path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and path != ROOT
    return path

def fingerprint(path):
    path = local(path)
    assert path.is_file()
    size = path.stat().st_size
    sha = hashlib.sha256()
    git = hashlib.new(object_format)
    git.update(('blob ' + str(size) + '\0').encode())
    seen = 0
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            seen += len(chunk); sha.update(chunk); git.update(chunk)
    assert seen == size == path.stat().st_size
    return {'path': path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'bytes': size, 'sha256': sha.hexdigest()}, git.hexdigest()

def keep(path, expected=None):
    record, oid = fingerprint(path)
    if expected:
        assert record['path'] == expected['path']
        assert all(record[key] == expected[key] for key in ('sha256', 'bytes') if key in expected)
    assert records.setdefault(record['path'], record) == record, 'Input changed'
    git_blobs[record['path']] = oid
    return record

def read(path, expected=None):
    record = keep(path, expected)
    data = local(path).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == record['sha256']
    return json.loads(data)

plan = read(PLAN)
binding = read(BINDING)
assert plan['schema'] == 'logos-engine.lot4b.regression-plan.v1'
assert binding['schema'] == 'logos-engine.lot4b.published-predecessor.v1'
assert binding['deployment']['status'] == 'succeeded'
commit = binding['source']['commit_sha']
assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', commit)
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--verify', commit + '^{commit}'], text=True).strip() == commit
tree_oid = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', commit + '^{tree}'], text=True).strip()
suite = plan['successfulTrajectorySuite']
inherited = read(suite['inheritedManifest']['path'], suite['inheritedManifest'])
assert inherited['schema'] == 'logos-engine.recorded-public-regression-cases.v1'
assert inherited['cases'] == suite['cases']
assert inherited.get('passiveOwnerRequirements', []) == suite['passiveOwnerRequirements'] == []
cases = suite['cases'] + suite['additionalCases']
assert [(r['id'], r['game']) for r in cases] == [
    ('catr-051', 'CATR'), ('rswp-051', 'RSWP'), ('fogw-051', 'FOGW'), ('vois-051', 'VOIS'),
    ('conn-050', 'CONN'), ('mind-051', 'MIND'), ('weav-051', 'WEAV'), ('tria-development-4b', 'TRIA')]
assert len({r['id'] for r in cases}) == 8
historical_record = suite['historical7AResults']['summary']
historical = read(historical_record['path'], historical_record)
assert historical['status'] == 'passed'
assert historical['passed'] == historical['total'] == len(historical['results']) == 7
assert historical['comparisonChecksPassed'] == historical['comparisonChecksExpected'] == 119
assert historical['caseManifest'] == suite['inheritedManifest']
published_source_name = 'docs/migration/lot7a-evidence/integrated-final/source-manifest.json'
published_source = read(published_source_name)
assert published_source == historical['nativeSource'] == historical['nativeSourceAfter']
assert published_source['digest'] == suite['historical7AResults']['nativeDigest']
assert published_source['fileCount'] == len(published_source['files'])
assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(dict(sorted(published_source['files'].items())), separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest() == published_source['digest']
tria = suite['triaDevelopmentBaseline']
tria_execution = read(tria['execution']['path'], tria['execution'])
tria_source = read(tria['sourceManifest']['path'], tria['sourceManifest'])
assert tria_execution['exitCode'] == 0 and tria_execution['nativeSourceUnchanged'] is True
assert tria_execution['executionCodeUnchanged'] is True
assert tria_execution['nativeSource'] == tria_execution['nativeSourceAfter'] == tria_source
assert tria_source['digest'] == tria['nativeDigest'] == tria_execution['nativeSourceManifestDigest']
assert tria_execution['report'] == tria['report'] and tria_execution['trace'] == tria['trace']

helper_name = 'scripts/evidence-byte-parts.py'
original_helper_name = 'scripts/restore-v53-evidence.py'
helper_records = [keep(helper_name), keep(original_helper_name)]
transports, initially_missing, probes = {}, [], set()
for case in cases:
    assert set(case) == {'id', 'game', 'baseline', 'trace'}
    for role in ('baseline', 'trace'):
        pin = case[role]
        assert set(pin) == {'path', 'sha256'}
        path = local(pin['path'])
        probes.add(pin['path'])
        if not path.is_file():
            initially_missing.append(pin['path'])
        parts_path = path.with_name(path.name + '.parts.json')
        if parts_path.exists():
            manifest = read(parts_path)
            assert manifest['schema'] == 'logos-engine.evidence-byte-parts.v1'
            assert manifest['original']['file'] == path.name and manifest['original']['sha256'] == pin['sha256']
            part_records = []
            for item in manifest['parts']:
                part_path = parts_path.parent / item['file']
                assert part_path.parent == parts_path.parent and part_path.name == item['file']
                part_records.append(keep(part_path, {'path': part_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'bytes': item['bytes'], 'sha256': item['sha256']}))
            transports[pin['path']] = {'manifest': keep(parts_path), 'parts': part_records, 'original': manifest['original']}
            probes.add(parts_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
            probes.update(row['path'] for row in part_records)
        else:
            assert path.is_file(), 'Missing original has no byte-parts transport'
for name in [suite['inheritedManifest']['path'], historical_record['path'], published_source_name]:
    probes.add(name)
raw_tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', commit, '--', *sorted(probes)])
members = {}
for raw in raw_tree.split(b'\0'):
    if raw:
        header, name = raw.decode().split('\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = header.split()
        assert kind == 'blob' and mode in ('100644', '100755')
        members[name] = {'path': name, 'mode': mode, 'type': kind, 'gitObjectId': oid}

def member(name):
    assert name in members, 'Input is absent from published commit: ' + name
    record = keep(name)
    assert git_blobs[name] == members[name]['gitObjectId'], 'Current bytes differ from published Git blob: ' + name
    return {**record, **{key: members[name][key] for key in ('mode', 'type', 'gitObjectId')}}

published_documents = [member(name) for name in [suite['inheritedManifest']['path'], historical_record['path'], published_source_name]]
membership = []
for case in cases[:7]:
    for role in ('baseline', 'trace'):
        pin = case[role]
        transport = transports.get(pin['path'])
        transport_members = []
        if transport:
            transport_members = [member(transport['manifest']['path']), *[member(row['path']) for row in transport['parts']]]
        direct = member(pin['path']) if pin['path'] in members else None
        assert direct is not None or transport_members, 'Published original must exist directly or through exact published byte parts'
        membership.append({'case': case['id'], 'role': role, 'original': pin,
            'mode': 'direct_blob' if direct else 'exact_published_byte_parts',
            'direct': direct, 'transportMembers': transport_members,
            'publishedCommit': commit, 'originalItselfTracked': direct is not None})

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lot4b_regression_transport_only', ROOT / helper_name)
transport_helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(transport_helper)
restored, verified_transports = [], []
for name, transport in transports.items():
    path = local(name)
    missing = not path.exists()
    result = transport_helper.verify(local(transport['manifest']['path']), restore=missing, directory=path.parent)
    assert result['path'] == name and result['sha256'] == transport['original']['sha256']
    assert result['bytes'] == transport['original']['bytes'] and result['restored'] is missing
    verified_transports.append(result)
    if result['restored']:
        restored.append({'original': keep(name), 'transport': transport['manifest'],
                         'operation': 'verify(..., restore=True, directory=original.parent)',
                         'originalAbsentBefore': True, 'existingInputsOverwritten': False})
actual_cases = []
for index, case in enumerate(cases):
    baseline, trace = (keep(case[key]['path'], case[key]) for key in ('baseline', 'trace'))
    if index < 7:
        row = historical['results'][index]
        assert row['case'] == case['id'] and row['game'] == case['game']
        assert row['baseline'] == baseline and row['trace'] == trace
        assert row['status'] == 'passed' and row['passed'] is True and row['comparisonChecks'] == 17
        historical_origin = {'kind': 'published_7a_regression_input', 'publishedCommit': commit,
                             'summary': keep(historical_record['path']), 'historicalRowStatus': row['status']}
    else:
        assert baseline == tria_execution['report'] and trace == tria_execution['trace']
        historical_origin = {'kind': 'retained_4b_development_live_input', 'execution': keep(tria['execution']['path']),
            'sourceManifest': keep(tria['sourceManifest']['path']), 'nativeSourceDigest': tria_source['digest'],
            'exitCode': tria_execution['exitCode'], 'published7AMembershipClaim': False}
    actual_cases.append({'id': case['id'], 'game': case['game'], 'baseline': baseline,
                         'trace': trace, 'historicalOrigin': historical_origin})
assert sorted(initially_missing) == sorted(row['original']['path'] for row in restored)
manifest = {'schema': 'logos-engine.recorded-public-regression-cases.v1',
    'cases': cases, 'passiveOwnerRequirements': inherited.get('passiveOwnerRequirements', []),
    'qualification': 'Declared final 4B regression inputs only: the seven inherited cases, order, paths and hashes are unchanged from the published 7A manifest, followed by the retained TRIA development case. Historical passing evidence is not a new replay result. LKEY partial preservation is separate. The actual final candidate is supplied later through the runner --source-manifest; no future native digest or version is assumed.'}
before = [records[name] for name in sorted(records)]
after = [fingerprint(row['path'])[0] for row in before]
assert after == before, 'Preparation input changed'
with OUT.open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(manifest, stream, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False); stream.write('\n')
manifest_record = fingerprint(OUT)[0]
after = [fingerprint(row['path'])[0] for row in before]
assert after == before
receipt = {'schema': 'logos-engine.lot4b-final-regression-input-preparation.v1', 'status': 'prepared_inputs_verified',
    'startedAt': started, 'finishedAt': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'generator': {'kind': 'inline_python_stdlib_with_existing_byte_transport_verifier',
                  'bodySha256': hashlib.sha256(PREPARATION_SCRIPT_SOURCE.encode()).hexdigest(),
                  'sourceBody': PREPARATION_SCRIPT_SOURCE,
                  'transportHelpers': helper_records},
    'plan': keep(PLAN), 'manifest': manifest_record, 'caseCount': 8,
    'caseOrder': [row['id'] for row in cases], 'inheritedCaseCount': 7, 'additionalDevelopmentCaseCount': 1,
    'exactPlanCasesPreserved': manifest['cases'] == suite['cases'] + suite['additionalCases'],
    'published7A': {'binding': keep(BINDING), 'siteVersion': binding['siteVersion'], 'commit': commit,
        'treeObjectId': tree_oid, 'gitObjectFormat': object_format, 'deploymentStatus': binding['deployment']['status'],
        'documents': published_documents, 'inputMembership': membership,
        'qualification': 'Git blob membership is verified against the exact published commit named by the retained root-observed Sites binding. Large ignored originals are proven through every published part and their published immutable manifest.'},
    'cases': actual_cases, 'initiallyMissing': initially_missing, 'restoredOriginals': restored,
    'verifiedByteTransports': verified_transports,
    'inputsBefore': before, 'inputsAfter': after, 'inputsUnchanged': True,
    'inputVerificationScope': 'Before and after manifest construction, after only authorized missing-original restoration; files absent at entry are listed separately.',
    'candidateSourceBinding': 'Provided later by --source-manifest after actual 5A publication and final 4B freeze.',
    'nativeEngineExecuted': False, 'originalAgentImported': False, 'campaignExecuted': False,
    'testExecuted': False, 'buildExecuted': False, 'measurementExecuted': False,
    'campaignReportsDecompressed': False, 'fullRunnerPreflightExecuted': False,
    'qualification': 'Executable input manifest and immutable provenance preparation only. Seven published historical regressions and one retained development live case remain historical evidence. The unchanged runner must still perform its full public-command/packet preflight and actual cold replays against the future supplied candidate freeze. No 8/136 passing result, new game success, final candidate version or cost result is claimed. No source, cost tool, existing report, trace, part or historical receipt was modified.'}
with RECEIPT.open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False); stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': receipt['status'], 'manifest': manifest_record,
    'preparation': fingerprint(RECEIPT)[0], 'caseOrder': receipt['caseOrder'],
    'publishedCommit': commit, 'publishedInputRoles': len(membership),
    'publishedTransportMembers': sum(len(row['transportMembers']) for row in membership),
    'restoredOriginals': [row['original'] for row in restored],
    'verifiedByteTransports': len(verified_transports), 'nativeEngineExecuted': False}, indent=2))
